WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost,
    AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS invoice_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio
  FROM invoice_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(invoice_stats.avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost,
  AVG(invoice_stats.invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  AVG(invoice_stats.invoice_ratio - overall.overall_avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio
FROM invoice_stats
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE invoice_stats.invoice_ratio > overall.overall_avg_ratio;
